1x01.d: In October 2006, people around the world discover that they have superpowers. High school student Claire Bennet finds herself spontaneously regenerating.
1x01.title: Genesis

1x02.d: Hiro time travels more than a month into the future of New York City; there he finds Isaac dead, and witnesses a nuclear explosion.
1x02.title: Don't Look Back

1x03.d: Peter begins to date Isaac's ex-girlfriend Simone. Hiro returns to the present and seeks the help of his friend, Ando Masahashi, to save New York from the upcoming explosion.
1x03.title: One Giant Leap

1x04.d: Matt is kidnapped by Claire's father and a Haitian. Hiro and Ando gamble in Vegas using Hiro's ability to freeze time, but are soon evicted from the hotel and assaulted by the security staff.
1x04.title: Collision

1x05.d: A Hiro from the future—who can speak English fluently—appears to Peter. He instructs Peter to save a cheerleader in order to save the world.
1x05.title: Hiros

1x06.d: Mohinder gives up searching for superhumans and returns to India. Niki's husband D.L. Hawkins—who can phase through solid objects—returns after breaking out of prison.
1x06.title: Better Halves

1x07.d: Matt works with the FBI to identify Sylar. They interrogate Ted Sprague, who can emit radiation. Parkman, by telepathy, accidentally finds out that his wife is cheating on him.
1x07.title: Nothing to Hide

1x08.d: Hiro and Ando meet diner waitress Charlie Andrews, who can perfectly remember everything that she has learned. Charlie is killed by Sylar shortly afterwards, and Hiro goes back in time to save her.
1x08.title: Seven Minutes to Midnight

1x09.d: Peter, despite warnings pointing to his death, rushes to the aid of the cheerleader, despite being convinced he is powerless alone.
1x09.title: Homecoming

1x10.d: Most of the events in this episode take place six months prior to the events in the previous episode.
1x10.title: Six Months Ago

1x11.d: Matt and the FBI investigate the Homecoming killing at Claire's school, having arrested Peter at the scene. When Matt tries to read Claire's mind he cannot because the Haitian is blocking his telepathy.
1x11.title: Fallout

1x12.d: Hiro goes on a quest to retrieve the sword of Feudal Japanese hero Takezo Kensei after meeting with Isaac and seeing his paintings.
1x12.title: Godsend

1x13.d: Claude agrees to teach Peter how to control his powers. Matt's wife reveals that she is pregnant. Claire contacts her biological mother Meredith Gordon, who possesses pyrokinesis.
1x13.title: The Fix

1x14.d: Sylar escapes from Bennet's captivity. Claude is convinced that Peter's loved ones are distracting him. To prove this, they follow Simone who kisses Isaac.
1x14.title: Distractions

1x15.d: Meredith informs Claire's biological father, Nathan, that Claire is alive. Meredith blackmails him for $100,000 by agreeing to keep quiet about this, as it could ruin his political career.
1x15.title: Run!

1x16.d: Bennet and the Haitian pursue Peter and leave a gun with Isaac. Claude leaves Peter because he does not want to become involved with Bennet again.
1x16.title: Unexpected

1x17.d: Matt and Ted take the Bennet family hostage. Ted loses control of his powers and burns the Bennets' house.
1x17.title: Company Man

1x18.d: Claire and the Haitian go to the house of Nathan and Peter's mother, Angela, who is also Claire's grandmother. Jessica/Niki returns to her home with D.
1x18.title: Parasite

1x19.d: Linderman reveals that his plan for Nathan includes Peter exploding. Linderman also shows Nathan one of Isaac's paintings, in which Nathan is the President of the United States.

1x20.d: Hiro and Ando find themselves five years after the destruction of New York. People with extraordinary abilities are labeled as terrorists and Sylar, who has assumed the form of Nathan, is the President.
1x20.title: Five Years Gone

1x21.d: Mohinder is introduced to Molly, who can normally locate any individual, but she has the Shanti Virus that killed Mohinder's sister many years before.
1x21.title: The Hard Part

1x22.d: Hiro's father teaches Hiro how to use a sword. Candice gets Micah to rig the election for Nathan to win. D.L. kills Linderman, but is shot in the process.
1x22.title: Landslide

1x23.d: Niki and Jessica come to peace as they rescue Micah. Hiro teleports Ando back to Japan to keep him safe. The Heroes face off against Sylar.
1x23.title: How to Stop an Exploding Man

2x01.d: In March 2007, Suresh and Bennet are conspiring to bring the Company down. Mohinder is hired by Bob Bishop of the Company.
2x01.title: Four Months Later...

2x02.d: Peter uses his powers and agrees to help the people who found him with their thefts. The Haitian reunites with Bennet. Maya kills people without touching them when under stress and then Alejandro revives them.
2x02.title: Lizards

2x03.d: It turns out that D.L. is dead. Niki leaves Micah under the care of his great aunt in New Orleans with strict instructions to hide his ability.
2x03.title: Kindred

2x04.d: Micah's cousin Monica Dawson discovers her own ability: muscle mimicking. Matt enlists Nathan's help to find the man who has been killing the Company founders, such as Kaito.
2x04.title: The Kindness of Strangers

2x05.d: A woman named Elle Bishop tries to find Peter and kills Ricky with her electric powers. Matt and Nathan visit Maury, who has put Molly into a deep sleep and has been giving her nightmares.
2x05.title: Fight or Flight

2x06.d: Peter and Caitlin go to Montreal after they find a plane ticket among Peter's possessions. Kensei betrays Hiro after Hiro kisses Kensei's love Yaeko.
2x06.title: The Line

2x07.d: Hiro returns to the present. Peter accidentally teleports himself and Caitlin over a year into the future in New York and find that 93% of the world's population has died of the Shanti Virus.
2x07.title: Out of Time

2x08.d: The episode depicts flashbacks that show what happened between the first and second seasons.
2x08.title: Four Months Ago...

2x09.d: The Bennet family prepares to go on the run before the Company finds them. Hiro goes back in time and discovers that Adam killed his father.
2x09.title: Cautionary Tales

2x10.d: Adam and Peter learn that the Shanti virus is being kept in Texas. Sylar kills Alejandro, Maya learns how to control her power, and Maya and Sylar make it to New York.
2x10.title: Truth & Consequences

2x11.d: Peter finds out that Adam actually wants to unleash the virus and stops him from doing so. Hiro buries Adam alive by teleporting him into a coffin.
2x11.title: Powerless

3x01.d: While Matt discovers the identity of the person who shot Nathan, Sylar seeks Claire to acquire her healing ability.
3x01.title: The Second Coming

3x02.d: Sylar confronts Elle at the Company, and 12 villains escape due to an ensuing battle.
3x02.title: The Butterfly Effect

3x03.d: Bennet and his new partner, Sylar, go after four villains at a bank heist. Peter tries to determine what goes wrong in the future.
3x03.title: One of Us, One of Them

3x04.d: Future Claire hunts down Peter (who gains Gabriel's ability and his hunger) in order to save the world. Tracy finds out about her origins while Mohinder learns the side effects of his power.
3x04.title: I Am Become Death

3x05.d: Claire faces Stephen Canfield (Andre Royo), an escaped villain that can create vortices. Peter has returned from the future, which he discovers has affected him deeply.
3x05.title: Angels and Monsters

3x06.d: Hiro and others accept offers to join Pinehearst. After the Company is paralyzed, Peter goes to Pinehearst, its rival, for information.
3x06.title: Dying of the Light

3x07.d: Having become monstrous, Mohinder attacks Nathan and Tracy, who try to save Maya and other subjects. Elle surprises the Bennet family.
3x07.title: Eris Quod Sum

3x08.d: To prepare for an eventual showdown with his foes, Hiro investigates defining moments in the pasts of Arthur Petrelli (Robert Forster), Sylar, and Flint (Blake Shields).
3x08.title: Villains

3x09.d: Hiro escapes Arthur but believes himself to be ten years old. Arthur sends Knox and Flint to capture Peter and Claire. Ando helps Hiro re-discover his powers.
3x09.title: It's Coming

3x10.d: A second eclipse causes all of the heroes to lose their abilities. Arthur sends Elle and Sylar to capture Claire, who is under the care of her father and training to be able to fight off the villains.
3x10.title: The Eclipse

3x11.d: A second eclipse causes all of the heroes to lose their abilities. Arthur sends Elle and Sylar to capture Claire, who is under the care of her father and training to be able to fight off the villains.
3x11.title: The Eclipse

3x12.d: To stop Arthur once and for all, Hiro and Claire travel back 16 years in time to when Hiro's father, Kaito (George Takei), handed baby Claire to Noah, while Peter teams up with the Haitian to finally stop Arthur, only…
3x12.title: Our Father

3x13.d: After the death of Arthur, the Petrelli brothers find themselves against each other and Nathan makes a move that will have repercussions on the world.
3x13.title: Dual

3x14.d: After the destruction of Primatech and Pinehearst, the Heroes attempt to start new lives. Nathan Petrelli gains President and government support to hunt and capture all people with abilities.
3x14.title: A Clear and Present Danger

3x15.d: Following a chain of unexpected events, the Heroes are on the run from Nathan and Danko (Željko Ivanek). A series of prophetic paintings reveals the tragic fate of someone close to Matt.
3x15.title: Trust and Blood

3x16.d: Nathan's plans face exposure when the President (Michael Dorn) orders Homeland Security to start an investigation.
3x16.title: Building 26

3x17.d: Matt interrogates the captured Noah to find out how he began working with Nathan to abduct those with abilities. The information Matt uncovers leads Peter to confront Danko.
3x17.title: Cold Wars

3x18.d: Acting on a tip from "Rebel", Peter and Matt head to Building 26 to find Daphne. Claire helps Alex escape and is assisted by her mother, Sandra.
3x18.title: Exposed

3x19.d: Sylar finds his father and learns that he is dying of cancer. Claire contemplates whether she should help Eric Doyle. Nathan and Danko engage in a power struggle over operations of Building 26.
3x19.title: Shades of Gray

3x20.d: Danko considers releasing Tracy so she'll lead him to Rebel.
3x20.title: Cold Snap

3x21.d: Nathan and Claire go hiding in Mexico. Danko's plan to destroy everyone with abilities is set into motion with an unlikely ally.
3x21.title: Into Asylum

3x22.d: Matt is out for revenge against Danko. Hiro and Ando continue their road trip to deliver Matt Parkman Jr. to his father. Angela, Nathan, Peter and Claire come together to unearth secrets from the past.
3x22.title: Turn and Face the Strange

3x23.d: Angela reveals the dark secrets that have haunted her for years, while Mohinder learns that his father was involved in a long-forgotten government operation.

3x24.d: Sylar has an unexpected identity crisis while continuing to work with Danko. Hiro and Ando plan to take down Building 26. Matt's newfound fatherhood changes his plans.
3x24.title: I Am Sylar

3x25.d: Nathan and Peter try to prevent Sylar from meeting the President. Angela seeks out Matt because of a dream that he will save Nathan.
3x25.title: An Invisible Thread

4x01.d: Double-length episode. Claire starts as a freshman in college, but cannot fully leave her old life behind. Peter returns to his job as a paramedic, saving people with the help of Mohinder's abilities.
4x01.title: Orientation

4x02.d: Double-length episode. Claire starts as a freshman in college, but cannot fully leave her old life behind. Peter returns to his job as a paramedic, saving people with the help of Mohinder's abilities.
4x02.title: Orientation

4x03.d: Samuel attempts to manipulate Peter into filling his brother's position at the carnival. While facing the consequences of this, Peter meets a reluctant new hero.
4x03.title: Ink

4x04.d: Hiro distracts himself by helping others, and in the process learns to accept his own situation. Angela helps Nathan remember his past, but instead uncovers a long-buried secret.
4x04.title: Acceptance

4x05.d: Sylar wakes up with no memories. Claire discovers that there is more to her new roommate than what she already knows. Peter helps Emma to better understand her ability.
4x05.title: Hysterical Blindness

4x06.d: Sylar starts his journey to rediscover himself with the help of Samuel. Hiro shows Emma how to accept her ability and the possibilities it brings.
4x06.title: Tabula Rasa

4x07.d: Matt looks for a way to get rid of Sylar after he learns to take control of his body. Noah enlists the help of Tracy in order to help free Jeremy from the police.
4x07.title: Strange Attractors

4x08.d: Hiro travels three years into the past to save Charlie's life from the hands of Sylar, only to have things complicated by Samuel's presence.
4x08.title: Once Upon a Time in Texas

4x09.d: Though Peter's new ability is helpful in his job, it is trying on him until he uses it to help Emma. Claire learns that the sorority rush attack happened because of something her father did.
4x09.title: Shadowboxing

4x10.d: Mohinder discovered something shocking on an old film reel nine weeks ago. Hiro travels back in time to retrieve that film for Samuel.
4x10.title: Brother's Keeper

4x11.d: Three Thanksgiving dinners. The Petrellis: Nathan and Peter confront Angela about the truth with disastrous consequences. The Bennets: a dinner full of drama between Claire and Noah.
4x11.title: Thanksgiving

4x12.d: Claire travels to the carnival and finds an open invitation. Noah confesses the truth to Lauren about their past relationship.
4x12.title: The Fifth Stage

4x13.d: Claire searches for answers as she is suspicious of Samuel's true motives. Samuel seeks out Emma in hopes she can help him find someone.
4x13.title: Upon This Rock

4x14.d: Peter has trouble coping with Nathan's death as Claire tries to console him. Sylar returns to the Carnival to kill Samuel, only to discover something unexpected.
4x14.title: Let It Bleed

4x15.d: Hiro and Ando travel to Florida to rescue Mohinder from a mental institution. Noah seeks out Matt to help him with a lead on dealing with Samuel.
4x15.title: Close to You

4x16.d: Hiro falls into a tumor-induced hallucination in which he goes on a trial of his life for changing the past. Sylar confronts Claire in hope that she will help him figure out the truth behind his problems.
4x16.title: Pass/Fail

4x17.d: Peter pursues a way of keeping his dream of Emma from coming true. Sylar seeks out Matt in hopes Matt will help remove his powers.
4x17.title: The Art of Deception

4x18.d: Peter tries to help Sylar free himself from his own nightmare. Samuel tries to convince Claire to join his family by revealing dark secrets from Noah's past to her.
4x18.title: The Wall

4x19.d: Samuel's ultimate plan takes effect as Emma is forced into using her abilities to help him kill thousands of people, only to have an unlikely pair of heroes come to her rescue.
4x19.title: Brave New World

HR1x01.d: On June 13, in Odessa, Texas, Primatech, the leaders in "Evo" research, are hosting a peace summit for Evos and humans to come together, when the venue is bombed.
HR1x01.title: Brave New World

HR1x02.d: Tommy uses his powers to save himself and his friend Emily from Luke and Joanne Collins, a ruthless vigilante assassin couple who are killing evos, but nearly gets himself caught.
HR1x02.title: Odessa

HR1x03.d: In the far north, the young Malina uses her power to suppress the malignancy that is approaching. Meanwhile, Molly Walker, who has the power to locate other Evos, has been captured by two agents from Renautas.
HR1x03.title: Under the Mask

HR1x04.d: When Tommy and his mother end up in a car crash, Tommy teleports her to a hospital before passing out.
HR1x04.title: The Needs of the Many

HR1x05.d: Ren gathers a group of Evernow fans cosplaying as Katana girl at Renautas so that Miko can enter the building undetected.
HR1x05.title: The Lion's Den

HR1x06.d: Carlos learns about a place that is keeping Evos. Miko and Ren return to Evernow to save the "Master of Time and Space." Tommy runs away to Paris with Emily, but learns that nowhere is safe.
HR1x06.title: Game Over

HR1x07.d: Mohinder Suresh meets with Angela Petrelli, who tells him that she knows of the coming disaster and the Evos who can stop it.
HR1x07.title: June 13th Part One

HR1x08.d: Noah shoots Erica in the leg due to past-Noah's intervention, and Quentin finds them, and interrogates Erica about Phoebe.
HR1x08.title: June 13th Part Two

HR1x09.d: Anne tells Tommy that he has Hiro's powers, and Noah shares Nathan's history, but Tommy finds it difficult to believe. Luke struggles to come to terms with Malina's idea of fate, and opens up to her about his son.
HR1x09.title: Sundae, Bloody Sundae

HR1x10.d: Noah takes charge of Malina, refusing to trust Luke. Meanwhile, Tommy wakes up in Erica's house, with a strange scar on his neck and still unable to use his powers.
HR1x10.title: 11:53 to Odessa

HR1x11.d: At Sunstone Manor, in the midst of an assault by the Harris army, Farah and Carlos (as El Vengador) search for Carlos's friends while René and Taylor confront Matt Parkman.
HR1x11.title: Send in the Clones

HR1x12.d: Word is spreading about the solar flare. Tommy leaves when he hears that Renautas is saving only 12,000 people. Matt trades Taylor for three Gateway watches to save his family.
HR1x12.title: Company Woman

HR1x13.d: Tommy's powers open the Gateway portal. Ren and Emily awaken Otomo and the real Miko. Luke sacrifices himself to absorb the first solar flare.
HR1x13.title: Project Reborn
